## Human review verdict — chalbert/web-everything#1552

**Verdict:** ✅ pass — no blocking findings

### Panel verdicts

| lens | weight | verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| correctness | mandatory | accept |

### Findings (1)

**structure** (1)
- `scripts/operations/__tests__/backlog-ops-integration.test.mjs:92` — A missing closing brace leaves one describe block unclosed, causing two sibling describe blocks to be accidentally nested inside it, compensated by two extra closing braces at the end of the file. — The `describe('claim — the dirty-file probe…')` block opened at line 43 is never closed with its own `});` after the last `it` block (line 92 only closes the `it`/`withRealRepo` pair). `describe('claim + scaffold…')` (line 94) and `describe('resolve…')` (line 161) end up nested inside it instead of being siblings, and two extra `});` at lines 279-280 close the accidental extra level plus the true top level. Verified harmless: `node --check` passes, and all 13 tests in this file run and pass under `vitest run`, each correctly isolated in its own `withRealRepo`/`withBareOrigin` fixture — nested `describe` blocks are syntactically and behaviorally legal in Vitest (same lifecycle, no shared state). The only visible effect is that Vitest reports the `claim + scaffold` and `resolve` groups' names nested under the `claim` group's path instead of as siblings — a reporting/readability quirk, not a behavioral one. _[CONFIRMED]_ _[impact if unfixed: cosmetic]_
  - _Prevention (OWED — file it):_ An indentation-consistency lint/formatter check (e.g. ESLint `indent`, or Prettier in check mode) over test files would flag the closing `});` at the wrong indentation level and catch the mis-nesting visually; this repo's `check:standards` currently does not catch it (the PR itself reports 0 errors/1434 warnings with this defect present).

---

**Decision:** `accept` — recorded by operator.
**Lens:** `correctness` — a SINGLE-LENS run. One `judge` step, one juror, one lens; the table above lists only the lens that judged. The other 3 panel lenses (security, simplicity, standards-conformance) did NOT run and are not reported as unjudged.
Net basis: `1203f319668ba9ad0bc7c7813d4078a01f59b9a3..16763d4236a5239b1fc6265a16e77bb8ff7959a4` (rev `origin/lane/ops-integration-harness` at review time) — 8 net changed file(s) vs current main (#2450), not `gh pr diff`'s three-dot list.

_Recorded through the declared `review-pr` operation (#3035)._
